headline: Canadian Dollar Falls Toward 1.40 as Traders Boost Bank of Canada Rate Hike Bets
summary: USD/CAD neared 1.4000 as traders and economists increased bets on a Bank of Canada interest rate hike, following weakened business sentiment and lingering inflation concerns.
why: Expectations of policy tightening alter foreign exchange dynamics, directly influencing cross-border trade costs and currency pair valuations.

impacts.name: US Dollar / Canadian Dollar
impacts.why: Surging rate hike expectations for the Bank of Canada strengthened bets surrounding domestic monetary tightening.

why_moved: The currency pair approached key technical levels as rising rate hike expectations shifted interest rate differentials in favor of the Canadian dollar.
